title: Faster transfers and clearer progress dialogs
notes: Copy and move transfers can now process files in parallel while the file list is still being gathered, making large transfers feel faster.
The transfer progress dialog now shows file counts, keeps worker details aligned, and supports keyboard shortcuts and command-palette actions. Long worker names are also easier to read.
Frameless dialogs now have clearer outlines, making their boundaries easier to spot.
The app and installer now consistently use the fman++ product name.
